Name: Lenient Stashing - Add to Existing Stacks Change
Author: zombifier
Description:
Previously, if you have flavored honey, flowers of multiple colors or qualities, you cannot automatically add them into chests with "Add to existing stacks" if the existing items inside the chest is of a different color/quality/flavor. This mod makes it so you can.

See screenshot demonstration for more info.

Highly recommended for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29299]Fresh Farm Produce[/url], which can make items of different freshness level!

Source: [url=https://github.com/zombifier/My_Stardew_Mods/tree/master/LenientStashing]https://github.com/zombifier/My_Stardew_Mods/tree/master/LenientStashing[/url]

Downloads.Description: 1.0.1: Add compatibility with Unlimited Storage's item grab menu.
